riley: FYI rolling ensemble rollout (fp16 + microq-int4 ensemble) to dedicated yesterday. this morning we see NDJSON framing/parse issues for tool-calling routes — mainly when responses include multiple top-level objects or mixed types. parse failures ~2.9% on ensemble vs 0.1% on fp16 baseline.

infra-bot: Deploy 1711059000 by @riley -> dedicated/ensemble/microq (progress: 100%)

jordan: sample stream (trimmed):
```
{"invocation": {"tool": "mirror","args": ["/status"]}}
{"invocation": {"tool": "write","args": "note:ok"}}
```

priya: note the second object has args as a string not an array. also there is no newline separator in some streams and sometimes objects glue together `}{` when chunking occurs.

chen: looks like streaming chunk boundary + tokenizer split differences in int4 ensemble members. when shards disagree on split points we see fragments like: `...\n}]\n}{\n{"` which trips our NDJSON parser expecting newline between objects.

eval-bot: Recent metrics (last 30m): ensemble_ndjson_parse_error=2.9%, fp16_ndjson_parse_error=0.12%, downstream_arg_mismatch=0.45%

riley: That's higher than our safe threshold. can we reproduce locally with the failing prompt set (seeded)?

jordan: I ran a 5k seeded replay across ensemble and single-weight fp16. reproduction rate ~95% for failing cases. token-level diffs show split point shifts in ~seeds where outputs contain adjacent objects or NDJSON streams.

priya: example problematic token streams:
FP16 tokens: [..., '}', '\n', '{', '"invocation"', ...]
INT4 tokens: [..., '}', '}', '{', '\n', '{', '"invocation"', ...]  <-- extra brace injected due to misaligned tokenization and rounding in quantized softmax

chen: two quick hypotheses: 1) ensemble averaging during beam/temperature sampling introduces fractional logits that quantization discretizes differently per shard, leading to off-by-one token insertion; 2) streaming chunking size too small and we occasionally cut inside a multibyte token representation that some shards reconstruct differently.

devex: mitigation options (low-risk first):
- enable NDJSON-framing-sentinel for ensemble (prefix each object with `\u241E` or similar) on canary/dedicated for 2h
- soft-validate-and-repair: if NDJSON parse fails, attempt to split with regex heuristics and SLO-limited repair (1 retry)
- fall back to single-weight fp16 for routes with nested top-level objects
- increase stream chunk size or add chunk-anchoring to avoid cutting multibyte tokens

jordan: I like sentinel framing for the short term; it's low change and avoids guessing repairs. canary it to 1% traffic on dedicated.

riley: agree. roll sentinel-frame for 1% for 2 hours and snapshot any repaired outputs to blob for offline audit. also tag all outputs with `x-output-mode: framed-v1` header so downstream can opt-in.

infra-bot: Feature-flag `ndjson-sentinel` enabled for dedicated/ensemble slice=1% by @riley

priya: parallel experiments to run:
- replay with chunk_size=8KB vs 32KB to see chunk-boundary correlation
- run ensemble with deterministic argmax sampling to remove fractional averaging and compare
- tokenizer probe: check token ID sequences across quantized shards for the same byte offsets

eval-bot: queued eval jobs:
- ndjson-frag/171105/2k-chunk-probe
- ensemble-vs-fp16/171105/5k-seed-replay

chen: if sentinel reduces parse errors, we still need a long-term fix: either harmonize tokenization across quantized shards (quant-aware tokenizer retrain) or postprocess that enforces NDJSON boundaries (reject partial object and ask for retry).

riley: good point. let's treat sentinel as a signal gate while we measure. if downstream_arg_mismatch stays >0.3% after 1h, we abort ensemble rollout.

devex: rolling sentinel + snapshot + retry=1 for parse failures on the 1% slice now. also adding dashboard tile for framed-v1 parse_rate and downstream mismatches.

infra-bot: Patch apply queued by @devex -> feature-flag ndjson-sentinel for dedicated/ensemble (slice=1%)

jordan: quick note: some integrators rely on raw NDJSON without sentinels. we'll surface the change in product notes and provide a small client lib to strip sentinels in SDKs.

priya: action items:
- jordan: run chunk-probe & token-id comparison (ETA 3h)
- chen: run deterministic-ensemble replay (ETA 2h)
- devex: monitor sliceshot + snapshots and alert if downstream mismatch >0.3%
- riley: pause rollout if mismatch >0.3% after 1h

riley: TL;DR: ensemble rollout shows NDJSON framing and type-mismatch issues due to quantized shard disagreements + chunk boundaries. short-term: sentinel framing + 1 retry + snapshotting on 1% slice. follow-ups: chunk-size probe, quant-aware tokenizer check, deterministic sampling test.

eval-bot: Will post eval results to this thread when jobs complete.

jordan: posting first quick stat from chunk-probe (early): chunk_size=8KB => parse_error 3.1%, chunk_size=32KB => parse_error 0.9% (preliminary)
